title: مخزن الادویه (Makhzan al-Adviyah, Persian materia medica)
shelf_note: A lithographed Persian materia medica. This leaf is from its drug-name glossary (farhang). It belongs on the McGill Osler / Medical Heritage Library shelves it is catalogued under.
structure_note: The running head reads 'فرهنگ مخزن الادویه فارسی مع تحفة المؤمنین', which marks this leaf as the appended glossary. That glossary has its own pagination ('۵۴' or '۵۳' here, at record 758), so the 43 backsteps and 15 repeats most likely come from separately paginated parts (main text, glossary, Tuhfa), not from a broken scan order. Only 145 of 778 pages have a printed number, so some of the steps may also be misread numerals. The counts disagree: structure.pages_translated is 0, but pages_translated_field is 731 and this page has a translation. One of the two instruments is wrong (E2).

missing.english: <term>Kalkala</term>, with <term>a</term> on the first letter and the second letter unvowelled
missing.why: This is the lexicographers' pronunciation formula (bi-fatḥ-i avval va sukūn-i thānī). A general reader cannot tell it is a pronunciation guide, so it reads as nonsense.

book_verdict: This is a genuine 1913 Persian materia medica on the right shelf. On this glossary leaf, though, the OCR drops nearly all of the diagonal side-panel text, fills the lower table and the closing passage with repetition loops, and the translation renders that garble as fluent English. An expert would flag the leaf on sight.
